marksInFile: Selected print marks are included in the PDF, outside the artwork.
dialogDescription: Choose what to export. Preview it before saving.
cmykHint: CGATS21 CRPC6 ICC profile. White paper; transparent areas are flattened. Confirm the profile with your printer.
srgbHint: sRGB for screens and the web.
printHint: Print settings apply to PDF. Artwork outside the trim is retained in the bleed.
backgroundHint: Export continues if you close this dialog.
leaveDescription: Leaving this project will cancel the export. Would you like to stay until it finishes?
cmykCanvasHint: The canvas previews the CGATS21 CRPC6 print profile used for CMYK export, on white paper.
mutedPreview: Muted preview. Audio settings apply to the exported file.
unavailable: Composition export is unavailable in this session.
stale: The export target changed. Open the export popover again.
previewHint: The exported file uses the selected resolution.
estimateHint: Based on the data encoded so far. The final size can still vary.
centerSelectionHint: Keeps the artboard size and centers the selected layer for preview and export. Preserves its animation without changing the project.
targetSizeHint: Based on the target bitrate. Variable bitrate can produce a smaller or larger file. The estimate updates during export.
measuredSizeHint: Size of the last completed export with these settings.
